text: CLI can download and run models directly from Hugging Face by repo name
Models are loaded and run in the GGUF format
Can start a local server (with OpenAI-style API) loading a model straight from Hugging Face
Ships a built-in web chat UI that talks to the local server
quote: Built-in web UI against `llama serve` running Qwen 3.6

text: Supports vision-language model chat sessions from the CLI
Implemented in plain C/C++ with no external dependencies, buildable from source
quote: Plain C/C++ implementation without any dependencies

text: First-class optimized acceleration on Apple Silicon via ARM NEON, Accelerate, and Metal
quote: Apple silicon is a first-class citizen - optimized via ARM NEON, Accelerate and Metal frameworks

text: Uses AVX, AVX2, AVX512 and AMX instruction sets for faster x86 CPU inference
quote: AVX, AVX2, AVX512 and AMX support for x86 architectures

text: Supports integer quantization from 1.5-bit up to 8-bit for smaller memory footprint and faster inference
quote: 1.5-bit, 2-bit, 3-bit, 4-bit, 5-bit, 6-bit, and 8-bit integer quantization for faster inference and reduced memory use

text: Custom GPU kernels support NVIDIA CUDA, AMD (HIP), and Moore Threads (MUSA) hardware
quote: Custom CUDA kernels for running LLMs on NVIDIA GPUs (support for AMD GPUs via HIP and Moore Threads GPUs via MUSA)

text: Can hybrid-run across CPU and GPU to serve models larger than available VRAM
quote: CPU+GPU hybrid inference to partially accelerate models larger than the total VRAM capacity

text: Can be run inside Docker containers
quote: Run with Docker - see our [Docker documentation](docs/docker.md)

text: Prebuilt binaries are available from the GitHub releases page
Supports GBNF grammars to constrain generated output to structured formats
Open contribution process where contributors can become recognized collaborators
quote:
Contributors can open PRs
- Collaborators will be invited based on contributions
